info.title: Workable MCP
info.description: Workable is a hiring and HR platform. This MCP server lets an agent work with a user's Workable account: browse and search jobs, review and action candidates through the hiring pipeline, look up employees and the org chart, manage requisitions, offers, departments and members, and handle time off, time tracking, performance reviews.

post.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint for the Workable MCP server. Exposes Workable recruiting (ATS) and HR tools to the agent. The agent should call get_accounts first to discover the account subdomains the signed-in user can reach, then pass the chosen subdomain as the account argument of every other tool.

401.description: Unauthorized. The OAuth token is missing, invalid, or expired.

500.description: Internal server error from the Workable MCP server.

scopes.r_candidates: Read candidates, candidate activities, files and offers
scopes.w_candidates: Create and update candidates, and move, copy, relocate, disqualify or requalify them
scopes.r_jobs: Read jobs, job stages, members, recruiters, application forms and activities
scopes.r_requisitions: Read requisitions and their custom attributes
scopes.w_requisitions: Create, update, approve and reject requisitions
scopes.w_comments: Post comments and evaluations on candidate profiles
scopes.r_account: Read account details, custom attributes, legal entities and work schedules
scopes.w_departments: Create, update, merge and delete departments
scopes.w_members: Invite, update, enable and remove account members
scopes.r_employees: Read employees, employee documents and the org chart
scopes.r_timeoff: Read time off balances, requests and categories
scopes.w_timeoff: Create time off requests and approve or reject pending ones
scopes.w_time_tracking: Create and update time entries and clock in or out
scopes.r_reviews: Read performance review cycles, forms, tasks and results
scopes.w_reviews: Create review cycle templates and update, submit, share and sign reviews
scopes.r_reports: Run reporting searches over employees, candidates and profile updates
